title: Wally package manifest
description: A Wally package: what it is, and the packages it depends on.

additionalProperties.description: `scope/name@version`, such as `roblox/roact@^1.4.4`. A version requirement: `^1.2.3` (the default meaning), `=1.2.3`, `>=1.2, <2`.

name.description: `scope/name`, in lowercase: the scope is the publisher's.

registry.description: The index packages are found in.

enumDescriptions: Runs on the server and clients: installed in Packages.
Runs only on the server: installed in ServerPackages.
Only for development, such as tests: installed in DevPackages.

license.description: An SPDX license expression, such as `MIT`.

include.description: Files published with the package (globs); everything by default.

exclude.description: Files left out of the published package (globs).

place.description: For a game: where Wally's packages are in it, so packages that depend on each other find them.

shared-packages.description: The instance shared packages are in, such as `game.ReplicatedStorage.Packages`.

server-packages.description: The instance server packages are in, such as `game.ServerScriptService.Packages`.

dependencies.description: Packages for the server and clients, installed in Packages.

server-dependencies.description: Packages only the server uses, installed in ServerPackages.

dev-dependencies.description: Packages for development, such as test frameworks, installed in DevPackages.
